messages:
Mira Patel: Heads-up — AWS Marketplace asked for SOC2 Type II, recent external pen-test (summary + remediation), and the completed seller questionnaire by EOD next Tues. Can we confirm owners?
Carlos Nguyen: I can pull the SOC2 PDF from our compliance bucket. Which period do they need (last 12 months vs report date)?
Mira Patel: They said most recent report covering controls in effect during the last 12 months, plus an assertion letter. If it's not in the repo, link it here.
Jen Lee: @Carlos please also redact customer-specific attachments before sharing. I can handle redaction if needed.
Carlos Nguyen: Got it. I see SOC2_2024_TypeII.pdf in gs://redwood-compliance/reports. I'll prepare a redacted copy and upload to the partnership drive.
Sam Ortiz: For the pen test, they typically want an executive summary + the remediation tracker. Our external vendor gave a full report and a follow-up fixes log in Jan. I can export the fix list.
Mira Patel: Perfect. Also they asked for answers to the marketplace security questionnaire (10 pages). Does anyone have the latest filled version?
Jen Lee: We have a draft in Confluence -> Security -> Marketplace. I updated answers for encryption and KMS. Link: https://confluence.redwood/sec/marketplace-qna (internal).
Carlos Nguyen: Quick Q: Do we include network diagrams in the artifacts? They asked about isolation for private deployments.
Sam Ortiz: Yes — include a sanitized VPC diagram and a note about Private deployment options (on-prem / VPC peering). Use the standard redwood sanitized diagram.
Mira Patel: Deadline reminder: partner intake team wants everything uploaded to the secure S3 share and the questionnaire completed by 2026-04-02 COB. Can we hit that?
Jen Lee: I can finalize the questionnaire by Tues morning if I get the pen-test remediation tracker.
Carlos Nguyen: Uploading redacted SOC2 to the drive now: s3://marketplace-evidence/redwood/2026/SOC2_redacted.pdf :white_check_mark:
Marketplace Bot: New artifact uploaded by Carlos Nguyen: SOC2_redacted.pdf (encrypted link sent to external reviewer).
Sam Ortiz: I uploaded pen-test-summary.pdf and remediation-tracker.csv to the same folder. Added a short README with contact points.
Mira Patel: Awesome — next steps: Jen to finish Qs, Carlos to confirm SOC2 signature page present, Sam to supply the remediation timeline. I'll coordinate the final zip and transfer to the marketplace intake.
Jen Lee: Working on questionnaire now. If anyone has standard phrasing for 'data retention' and 'logging retention' sections, paste here.
Carlos Nguyen: Standard snippet: "Logs retained 90 days by default, configurable via tenant policy; audit exports available on request and can be retained per contract." Use that.
Sam Ortiz: Also note: for Dedicated tenants we support customizable retention through our Console and can integrate with customer KMS.
Mira Patel: Great. When Jen marks the questionnaire done, I'll do one pass and then send to legal for a quick sign-off. After legal, I'll schedule the SFTP push.
Jen Lee: Done — questionnaire final version uploaded: marketplace-qna-final.docx
Mira Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll post the transfer confirmation once SFTP is complete. :thumbsup:
Marketplace Bot: SFTP transfer scheduled for 2026-03-29 23:00 UTC. Transfer will include: SOC2_redacted.pdf, pen-test-summary.pdf, remediation-tracker.csv, marketplace-qna-final.docx, sanitized-vpc-diagram.png
Carlos Nguyen: Noted. If intake asks for raw pen-test evidence, escalate to Mira. We may need vendor permission.
Mira Patel: Will do. End-of-thread status: artifacts staged, questionnaire complete, legal review pending.
